core.title: Architectural Wide Stile Mortise Exit Device, PDQ 6200MR03FA630MLR

text.description_html:
PDQ Architectural Wide Stile Mortise Exit Device

Mortise exit device for 48” door, night latch exit trim, fire rated, motorized latch retraction, satin stainless steel

Motorized Latch Retraction: Ultra quiet operation unique motor drive retracts Push Pad. Low power requirements. Suitable for pairing with Low Energy Power Operators. On-board diagnostic LED lights. Motor drive factory tested to over 500,000 cycles (Over 2 times the ANSI/BHMA 156.25 Grade 1 Standard).

For 48" Wide Fire Doors, furnished standard with sex nuts. Listed by U.L./U.L.C. and comply with U.L. 10C and UBC 7-2 (1997) for positive pressure. ANSI/BHMA Certified Grade 1, A156.3 2001 Exit Devices. “Fire Exit Hardware” labeled for up to 3 hours, Non-handed. reversible for left or right hand doors. Compliant with the 2014 Florida Building Code, which include a High Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) Product Approval: FL 21376. Meets requirements of the Buy American Act.

Keyed Night Latch Lever: Night Latch Function (ANSI F03) - Outside entrance by lever when latch bolt is retracted by Key. (Lever only opens door when the key is turned). Key removable only when locked (Night Latch). Round rose (3-5/16" diameter) with ADA compliant Lever.

Specifications for PDQ 6200MR03FA630MLR Electric Latch Retraction Panic Device

  • Chassis: Cadmium plated steel
  • Rail: Extruded aluminum
  • Touch Pad: Stainless steel, 18" wide
  • Latch Bolt: Stainless steel dead locking with 3/4" throw
  • Projection: 3-1/8” projection
  • Hand: Device is non-handed
  • Dogging: None (Fire rated, non-dogging)
  • Application: Rim (8'0" tall door standard) / Covers 161 door prep
  • Stile Width: 4-1/4" minimum
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Door Width: Standard for 4'0" door (48" wide door)
  • Warranty: Ten (10) year limited warranty mechanical components
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
